flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4104 then book the free first visit class for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.

remark: click: Clicking Book free first visit button
click: Clicking the Free first visit class card
click: Clicking Continue on booking class selection
wait: queued plan (4 steps): type "Name"; type "Email"; select "Arrival time"; click "
click: Clicking the climbing waiver acceptance checkbox
click: Clicking Continue to submit the booking
wait: PRIMARY: wait 800 ms for booking confirmation to settle
analyze: the booking reference is stored as {{ref}}
assert: a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown

summary:
Booked Sam Rivera’s free first visit class for November 2, 2026 at noon using sam@example.com.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed, with reference code PL-7302.
